messages:
Raj (Partnerships): Quick proposal: a marketplace renewal accelerator for appliance SKUs. Offer a time-limited renewal credit if customers convert to a 12-month commit within 45 days of pilot completion. target: reduce churn and speed up ARR recognition.
Aiko (HW): Love it. HW partners want visibility into renewal uplift. ask: can partner co-fund part of the credit? they'd prefer 50/50 on select SKUs.
Jon (Marketplace): Technically doable as a private-offer with partner contribution metadata, but clouds differ. need partnerID and max_contribution_usd per offer. also, marketplace listings must show the effective discount clearly.
Marta (Finance): We need a cap and clawback language. suggest cap_per_customer = 120000 and clawback window = 90 days after renewal invoice. we'll model P&L impact.
Priya (Legal): Draft clause to prevent stacking with other promos and to require partner confirmation of contribution. I'll produce short T&Cs.
Leah (Sales): To qualify, sales must register the pilot and attach the offer ID in the deal. otherwise offers won't be honored. this prevents backdated credit claims.
Offer Bot: Draft private-offer created: https://mp.example.com/offers/draft-7701 (status: draft, requires partnerID, sku_map, contribution_terms).
Jon (Marketplace): Implementation sketch: offer fields = window_days:45, apply_to_months:3, partner_contribution_pct:50, cap_usd:120000, stacking_rule:exclusive. keep offer single-use per customer.
Raj (Partnerships): Nice. Next steps: Jon to confirm cloud policy differences by Fri; Aiko to gauge HW interest list; Marta to run 3 scenarios (no fund / partial fund / full fund); Priya to draft T&Cs; Leah to update pilot registration process. Sync Thurs 11am. :white_check_mark:
